tap.description: A MUD: a persistent text-based world where multiple players explore rooms, chat and cooperate in real time. TCP server handling connections, line-based protocol and a fully YAML-configurable world. Two clients: one in the terminal, the other graphical.

chip8.description: CHIP-8 emulator written from scratch: full instruction set, registers, stack, timers, 64×32 display and hexadecimal keypad via SDL2. A flag switches between the original behavior and that of modern interpreters on ambiguous opcodes.

amazeing.description: Maze generator and solver: six shapes (rectangle, square, circle, donut, diamond and ellipse), A* pathfinding, reproducible seed-based generation. Two-window interface, with the maze on one side and the controls on the other. The main window is resizable and lets you zoom and pan around the maze.
